title: Text-Only Domain Adaptation for Low-Resource Medical ASR: Shallow Fusion and Density Ratio Rescoring for Hausa
abstract: arXiv:2611.05744v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems often struggle with specialised medical vocabulary, especially in low-resource languages where domain-specific speech data are scarce. We investigate text-only domain adaptation for Hausa medical ASR using the fixed MMS-1B-FL102 acoustic model and two decoding-time language-model fusion methods: Shallow Fusion (SF) and the Density Ratio Approach (DRA). A 4-gram KenLM trained on 19,421 Hausa health sentences serves as the medical target model, while a 75,372-sentence general-domain model provides the source prior for DRA. Evaluation uses 250 recordings of 25 physician-reviewed prompts from 10 speakers across six northern Nigerian states. Under prompt-disjoint five-fold cross-validation, SF and DRA reduce WER from 29.56% to 23.55% and 23.33%, respectively. translated_title: 面向低资源医学自动语音识别的纯文本域自适应：豪萨语的浅融合与密度比重评分
translated_abstract: 自动语音识别（ASR）系统常常难以处理专业医学词汇，尤其是在缺乏领域特定语音数据的低资源语言中。我们研究了针对豪萨语医学ASR的纯文本域自适应方法，使用固定的MMS-1B-FL102声学模型以及两种解码时语言模型融合方法：浅融合（SF）和密度比方法（DRA）。基于19,421条豪萨语健康句子训练的4-gram KenLM作为医学目标模型，而由75,372条句子构成的通用领域模型为DRA提供源先验。评估使用了来自尼日利亚北部六个州的10名说话人针对25条经医生审阅的提示语录制的250条录音。在提示语不相交的五折交叉验证下，SF和DRA分别将词错误率（WER）从29.56%降至23.55%和23.33%。两者均显著优于贪婪解码（p < 0.001），而二者之间的差异不显著（p = 0.423）。然而，仅使用通用语言模型的SF……
tldr: 该研究提出仅需文本数据（无需医学领域语音数据）即可对豪萨语医学ASR进行域自适应，通过浅融合和密度比重评分两种解码时语言模型融合方法，将词错误率从29.56%显著降至约23.3%–23.5%。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that text-only domain adaptation for low-resource Hausa medical ASR—using shallow fusion and density ratio rescoring with a medical language model—significantly reduces WER from 29.56% to about 23.3–23.5% without requiring any domain-specific speech data.
